card.name: Just before a dose number begins
card.fires_on: The spot right before a numeric dose or strength is completed, such as a split decimal (0 then 2%), or a bracket or space before 2.5 mg or 75 mg. It also appears on word starts in phrases about what is appropriate or suitable.

modes.label: Split dose numbers
modes.description: A bracket, space, period or digit just before the rest of a dose or strength figure.
modes.example: conjugated estrogens (CE) [0.625 mg] combined with medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA)<< [>>2.5 mg], relative to placebo

modes.label: Start of appropriateness words
modes.description: Opening piece of words like appropriate, impractical or a verb in an 'options are inadequate' phrase.

card.writes: It lowers 'good' and raises 'suit/suitable', pushing toward wording about suitability rather than goodness.
card.plain: It fires just before a dose number is finished, and on words about whether something is appropriate.
